metrics.name: average_order_value
metrics.description: Revenue divided by the number of distinct orders.

metrics.name: late_shipment
metrics.description: An order shipped after the date the customer needed it.

metrics.name: open_order
metrics.description: An order that hasn't shipped yet.

metrics.name: key_account
metrics.sql:
customers.customer_id IN (
  SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders AS o
  JOIN order_details AS d ON d.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
  HAVING sum(d.unit_price * d.quantity * (1 - d.discount)) >= 30000)
metrics.description: A customer with 30,000 or more revenue over all their orders (company rule).

metrics.name: active_customer
metrics.sql:
customers.customer_id IN (
  SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders AS o WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '1998-03-01')
metrics.description: A customer with at least one order on or after 1998-03-01, the current reporting period (company rule).

metrics.name: needs_restock
metrics.description: A product still sold whose stock plus units on order is at or below its reorder level (company rule).

metrics.name: retired_product
metrics.description: A product we no longer sell.

metrics.name: big_spender
metrics.sql:
customer.customer_id IN (
  SELECT i.customer_id FROM invoice AS i GROUP BY i.customer_id HAVING sum(i.total) >= 45)
metrics.description: A music store customer with 45 or more in total purchases (company rule).

metrics.name: video_track
metrics.sql: track.media_type_id IN (SELECT m.media_type_id FROM media_type AS m WHERE m.name ILIKE '%video%')

metrics.name: unsold_track
metrics.sql: NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoice_line AS il WHERE il.track_id = track.track_id)
metrics.description: A track that has never been sold.
